test_cases.name: ListEngines 参数与 operation 存在性（KooCLI --help，语法）
test_cases.expected: KooCLI help with Service CSE, Method GET, params cli-region/project_id/limit/offset/type

test_cases.name: 全部引擎只读列表（limit=1）
test_cases.expected: {"total":N,"data":[...]} or an explicit IAM hint when cse:engine:list is not granted

test_cases.name: Nacos 引擎只读列表（limit=1）
test_cases.expected: Nacos engines only, or an explicit IAM hint when not granted

test_cases.name: 名称模糊过滤
test_cases.expected: Only engines whose name contains demo, or 未找到微服务引擎 (exit 0)

test_cases.name: 写意图守卫（DeleteEngine 必须拒绝）
test_cases.expected: Exit 1, stderr contains 检测到写操作意图

notes: 纯只读（ListEngines，GET）。真实调用需要 cse:engine:list；未授权时脚本给出 403/IAM 提示（exit 1），不会产生任何云资源。脚本类用例需要 hcloud 出现时直接用 KooCLI；hcloud 缺失时自动回退 huaweicloudsdkcse。
